ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.the.role: Warning shown while settings are slow to load
ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.the.tone: Calm, factual sentence; no blame, no alarm.
ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.the.length: Inline message that wraps in an alert or helper line. English is 125 characters.
ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.the.note: Appears after a delay with a Retry button. Product name "Local Operator" stays; the sentence also tells the user it will keep trying.

ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.you.role: Alert heading when the settings read fails
ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.you.tone: Neutral warning; says what happened and the next step, never blames the user.
ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.you.length: Inline message that wraps in an alert or helper line. English is 34 characters.
ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.you.note: Generic failure sentence; a more specific remedy sentence may be shown beside it.

ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.sig.role: Description under the Model providers heading
ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.sig.tone: Plain, friendly second person; explains rather than commands.
ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.sig.length: Wrapping paragraph in the settings content column (about 60-70 characters per line); no length cap, keep every fact. English is 81 characters.
ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.sig.note: Two short sentences. "The services your agents think with" means AI model providers; keep that figurative reading plain.

ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.bac.tone: Neutral noun phrase in sentence case.
ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.bac.length: Section or list heading; one line, sentence case. English is 16 characters.
ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.bac.note: Heading of the full registry section; same words as the sidebar entry.

ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.eve.role: Description under the Backend settings heading
ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.eve.tone: Helpful explanatory prose in second person.
ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.eve.length: Wrapping paragraph in the settings content column (about 60-70 characters per line); no length cap, keep every fact. English is 83 characters.
ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.eve.note: Terse list: every server setting, searchable, with editors suited to each value type, and scopes. "Scopes" means when a change takes effect (now, next launch, new conversations).

ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.ret.tone: Plain imperative; no exclamation, no please.
ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.ret.length: Button label; one line, never wraps. English is 5 characters; keep it a short verb phrase of similar width.
ui.settings.navigation.settings_page.ret.note: Re-requests the settings after a failure.
